title: Boundary Detection for High-Dimensional Point Clouds
abstract: arXiv:2610.23590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce two new methods for boundary detection in high-dimensional point cloud data, intended to work in situations with non-uniform density, high ambient dimension, and substantial noise. Our first method fits a separating hyperplane on local neighborhoods after doing local dimension reduction---this method works best when one can reliably estimate the intrinsic dimension of the data. Our second method measures the directional uniformity of local neighborhoods, and has the best overall performance on synthetic data. In addition to pointwise numerical boundary scores, our algorithms yield an estimated normal vector at each boundary point. We validate our methodology on synthetic data as well as two real examples: we analyze spatial transcriptomics data, where we show that we can detect the boundary of a tumor, and we also study LLM activation geometry.

translated_abstract: 我们提出了两种用于高维点云数据边界检测的新方法，旨在适用于密度不均匀、环境维度高且噪声较大的情况。第一种方法在进行局部降维后，于局部邻域上拟合一个分离超平面——当数据的内在维度可以被可靠估计时，该方法效果最佳。第二种方法通过测量局部邻域的方向均匀性来进行检测，在合成数据上取得了总体最优的表现。除了给出逐点的数值边界分数外，我们的算法还能在每个边界点处输出估计的法向量。我们在合成数据以及两个真实案例上验证了该方法：我们分析了空间转录组学数据，证明了能够检测肿瘤的边界；我们还研究了大型语言模型（LLM）的激活几何。
tldr: 本文提出两种适用于高维、非均匀密度且含噪点云数据的新型边界检测方法，可同时输出边界分数和法向量估计，并在肿瘤边界检测与LLM激活几何分析中得到验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two novel boundary detection methods for high-dimensional point clouds that work under non-uniform density and substantial noise, providing both pointwise boundary scores and normal vector estimates, validated on tumor boundary detection and LLM activation geometry.
